description: This script is designed to terminate all processes and clean up network and filesystem resources associated with the K3S Kubernetes distribution, including killing processes like container shims, unmounting filesystems, deleting network namespaces and interfaces, and clearing iptables rules.

methods.name: pschildren
methods.description: Finds child processes of a given process ID using ps.

methods.name: pstree
methods.description: Recursively prints the process tree starting from given PIDs.

methods.name: killtree
methods.description: Kills a process tree rooted at specified PIDs.

methods.name: do_unmount_and_remove
methods.description: Unmounts and removes filesystem paths matching a specific pattern.
